sn42.5:1.1: gāmaṇi → gāmaṇī (bj, sya-all) | upasaṅkamitvā → upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā (bj) | ekamantaṁ → bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṁ (pts) | assāroho → assārūho (bj: sī) | assāroho → S1-3 Assarūho always (pts note)
sn42.5:1.2: pubbakānaṁ ācariyapācariyānaṁ assārohānaṁ bhāsamānānaṁ → pubbakānam ācariyapācariyānam assārohānam bhasamānānaṁ (pts)
sn42.5:1.3: paraṁ maraṇā parajitānaṁ → parammaraṇā sarañjitānaṁ (bj) | parajitānaṁ → sarajitānaṁ (sya-all) | parajitānaṁ devānaṁ sahabyataṁ → sarājitānam devānam sahavyatam (pts) | enam → S1-3 tamena (pts note) | Sarājitānam → B1-2 parajitānam as before (pts note)
sn42.5:2.4: paraṁ maraṇā parajitānaṁ → parammaraṇā sarañjitānaṁ (bj) | parajitānaṁ → sarajitānaṁ (sya-all)
sn42.5:3.1: na labhāmi → nālatthaṁ (sya-all) | labhāmi → This phrase is missing in B1-2 as before (see p. 309 n.1) (pts note)
sn42.5:3.3: api ca kho → apica (bj) | kho → Missing in S1-3 (pts note)
sn42.5:3.4: pubbe gahitaṁ → pubbeva hīnaṁ (bj) | cittaṁ pubbe gahitaṁ dukkaṭaṁ → cittam pubbeva hīnaṁ duggataṁ (pts) | pubbeva → pubbe (bj: syā, machasaṁ) | vāyamati → S1-3 insert here --pe-- (pts note) | hīnaṁ → B1-2 pubbegahitaṁ as before (see p.309 n.2) (pts note) | duggataṁ → B1-2 dukkaṭaṁ (pts note)
sn42.5:3.5: bajjhantu → vajjhantu (sya-all) | mā → mā vā (sya-all) | vā → Missing in S1-3 (pts note) | mā → S1-3 insert vā as before (pts note)
sn42.5:3.6: paraṁ maraṇā parajito → parammaraṇā sarañjito (bj) | tattha upapajjati → tatthuppajjati (bj) | parajito → sarajito (sya-all); sarājito (pts) | upapajjati → B1-2 have as before parajito . . . nirayo . . . (pts note)
sn42.5:3.8: paraṁ maraṇā parajitānaṁ → parammaraṇā sarañjitānaṁ (bj) | parajitānaṁ → sarajitānaṁ (sya-all); sarājitānaṁ (pts)
sn42.5:4.6: paraṁ maraṇā parajitānaṁ → parammaraṇā sarañjitānaṁ (bj) | upapajjatīti → upapajjatīti abhikkantaṁ bhante (bj) | parajitānaṁ → sarajitānaṁ (sya-all); sarājitānaṁ (pts) | sahabyataṁ upapajjatīti → sahavyatam upapajjātīti (pts) | sarājitānaṁ → In this sutta S1-3 have always sarājita, B1-2 having, as before, parajita (pts note)
